verdict.rationale: Statsig is an experimentation platform, so scheduled recurring jobs are a fair capability to ask about, but the evidence pack documents none. The only scheduling evidence is a Feature Gate Scheduled Rollout, which is a one-off gradual rollout rather than a recurring schedule. Running the CLI from CI/CD is a user-side workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: a first-party capability to define recurring jobs or workflows (cron-style or interval triggers), schedule management via the UI, API or MCP, and run history or monitoring of scheduled executions.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
